title: Agents don't need rotating seats: a different process from humans (2026-11-10)

sections.name: narrative
sections.label: Narrative
sections.content: Our agents don't have to worry about rotating seats. Its a slightly different process to dealing with humans there ;-)

sections.name: source
sections.label: Source
sections.content: The owner, in conversation with Claude Code, 2026-11-10, answering the gap map of the programme's delegation against the anatomy in ~/dev/muDemocracy.org/reference/Delegation in historic small democracy.md, which listed no term, end date or rotation for working-group seats (vignette 45a49561). The first recorded divergence between the internal mirror (agents) and the external one (people). Recorded verbatim.
